🖋️ Cistercian Numeral Math

Perform math using medieval Cistercian numerals (0-9999). Each number is a single glyph on a vertical staff with 4 quadrants: ones (top-right), tens (top-left), hundreds (bottom-right), thousands (bottom-left).

Enter numbers and click Calculate to see Cistercian math
